We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Company
Looking for a company that inspires passion, courage and creativity, where you can be part of the team shaping the future of global commerce? Want to shape how millions of people buy, sell, connect, and share around the world? If you’re interested in joining a purpose driven community that is dedicated to crafting an ambitious and inclusive workplace, join eBay – a company you can be proud to be a part of.

With ~150 million active buyers across 190 countries and over 1 billion active product listings, eBay is the world’s most vibrant and dynamic online marketplace. Founded in 1995, eBay Inc. connects people around the world, enabling them to buy and sell online. eBay Inc. is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information about the company and its global portfolio of online brands, visit  www.ebayinc.com

About the team
We are responsible for setting the strategic direction of eBay: our ambition, where we play, and how we win in the market. The corporate strategy has a reputation of solving the most challenging problems and coming up with innovative and out-of-the-box solutions, with recommendations grounded in data.

We work very closely with senior leadership and have a high visibility. Team members can have a fast-track career in strategy or move into the business after 1-2 years.

The team is responsible for deeply understanding the needs of our core buyers and sellers and crafting the strategies that will differentiate eBay relative to our competitors. We work very closely with product, technology, and regional business teams to ensure the strategy is translated into action across the end-to-end customer experience. Our work can be divided into 3 main topics: 1) we develop eBay Inc’s strategy together with eBay’s executives, 2) we run strategic projects to solve key strategic issues supporting select executives at eBay, 3) we closely monitor the competitive environment & trends.

The opportunity

The eBay corporate strategy team is seeking a Principal, Corporate Strategy . Within this role, you will lead a cross-functional strategy project and a team of a few s trategy team members . You will work with key stakeholders from all functions across the organization to craft strategies and drive structured and data-based recommendations to action. In this role, you will have the ability to influence key elements of eBay’s strategy and to help shape the strategic direction of eBay, working with eBay’s senior executives. The ideal candidate has a track record of making pragmatic, concrete recommendations with real world implementation experience. It is critical for the role that the candidate has strong analytic skills and is excellent in developing creative/ out-of-the-box and well-thought-out solutions for challenging business problems. You can either build a career in eBay’s strategy team or use this as stepping stone into other business and product roles at eBay.

Role responsibilities:

- Project leadership: L ead cross-functional projects to solve strategic business problems, working with senior eBay executives. Projects are usually 2-4 months long, staffed with 1-3 team members supporting the Principal . Topics can span eBay’s overall strategy, category strategies, buyer/seller strategies or functional strategies (e.g., payments, ads) or other relevant strategic topics

- Insights generation: Work with your team and analytics/ data science support to define smart analyses and generate new, compelling insights. V isualize in simple and compelling ways. Use the insights to develop key recommendations grounded in data

- Strategy Development: Define and structure the core problem, understand status quo & competitive dynamics, define ambitions and value proposition and create recommendations for key actions to solve the problem

- Communication: Develop compelling and concise storylines to communicate team’s recommendation; prepare and deliver presentations to senior leadership

- People leadership: Develop a team of associates and managers to constantly improve and help them grow their career

Job Requirements:

- Intellectual curiosity

- Skilled in project management and strategy development, including project prioriti z ation, hypotheses development, financial and business modeling, strategic options identification, consensus building, and implementation

- O utstanding analytical capabilities (quantitative and qualitative) , ability to define relevant analyses in a hypothesis-driven approach, generating new & groundbreaking insights grounded in data

- Excellence in structured thinking , developing creative solutions to challenging strategic business problems. Creativity and “out of the box” thinking that drives innovation. Ability to “see around corners” and “connect the dots” that enable business to proactively drive business

- Strong executive presence and ability to communicate strategy clearly and simply. Ease with executive-level interactions . Ability to create clear and simple storylines.

- Proven track record to lead and mentor a driven strategy team in the development and execution of key initiatives . Ability to lead, empower and mentor project team members

- Comfort in reaching out and prioritizing cross-functional collaboration in a highly matrixed environment

- Comfort in handling uncertainty

- Highly collaborative – be fun, and easy to work with!

Qualifications

- Proven leader with at least 7+ years of work experience - experience at a top strategy consulting firm is a must;

- Experienced project managers, currently working at top strategy consulting companies. Leaders who spent at least 2-3 years at a top strategy consulting company and then advanced their careers for 4-5 years at a startup or corporate

- Bachelors Degree required, MBA or equivalent preferred

- Expertise in technology and/or in e-commerce/retail is a plus

Qoo10 is Japan’s leading eCommerce platform for beauty and one of the fastest-growing players, becoming the platform of choice for Gen Z in Japan. With 80% of our buyers being women, primarily Gen Z, who are passionate about beauty, we are at the forefront of shaping the future of beauty retail. As a leader in beauty eCommerce, we continuously push the boundaries of what's possible in the online space. From a beauty-centric cataloged database to a live commerce platform, we are transforming how Gen Z discovers and engages with beauty products.

We are seeking a member for the Operation Strategy team. The candidate is expected to drive further growth and innovation as we continue shaping the future of online beauty retail. The candidate will be a creative problem solver, passionate about the beauty industry, able to take ownership of key project workstreams with high levels of intellectual curiosity, and energized by new initiatives with a positive, hands-on attitude.  The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in ambiguity, brings an entrepreneurial mindset, and is able to balance strategic thinking with strong execution. Within this role, the candidate will have the ability to identify and execute cross-functional initiatives that drive business growth (including initiatives with eBay Global teams, live commerce, and other new business opportunities), refine Qoo10 operational strategy, effectively communicate with international teams in English, and deliver impactful reports and presentations.

Job Responsibilities include:
[Execution of Cross-Functional Initiatives]
- Identify and execute large-scale, high-impact cross-functional initiatives that drive business growth: such as live commerce, online/offline events, and new growth opportunities in the beauty business.

- Collaborate with multiple stakeholders, including international teams, on new opportunities.

- Enhance efficiency and operational excellence across the business by introducing and aligning best practices, processes and tools.

- Bring structure, momentum, and clear follow-through in ambiguous, fast-changing situations.

[Operation Strategy Development]
- Support development and refinement of medium-to-long-term operating strategies for priority programs.

- Translate business goals into actionable roadmaps, requirements, and operational playbooks.

- Build business cases and recommend tradeoffs (options, risks, dependencies, expected impact) to enable leadership decisions.

- Partner with stakeholders to move initiatives from idea to execution with clear ownership and milestones.

[Operation Analytics]
- Identify and analyze market trends, customer behavior, and operational challenges to diagnose issues and uncover opportunities for improvement.

- Drive impact by optimizing day-to-day operations, improving overall performance, and contributing to business growth.

- Analyze data and industry insights, competitor landscapes to inform and support decision-making.

[Market intelligence]
- Develop insightful market intelligence about key industry trends (technology, competitors, consumers, and so on).

[Reporting & communication]
- Prepare and deliver executive-level reports and presentations to Qoo10 and eBay Global leadership teams with compelling storytelling in English and Japanese.

- Communicate recommendations clearly and concisely to stakeholders across different functions and seniority levels.

Qualification Requirements:
- Bachelor's or equivalent experience or master's degree

- 5+ years of relevant professional experience, ideally in consulting, global eCommerce/retail, beauty, business development, trading house, or similar cross-functional roles. Experience that combines strategy/planning with hands-on execution is especially valued.

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

- Strong analytical skills (ability to structure problems, interpret data, and drive decision-making).

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across diverse teams and seniority levels.

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse, cross-functional, and global teams.

- Fluent level of English and Japanese language skill (reading, writing, speaking).

- Be self-driven, detail-oriented, and able to tackle complex problems in a structured and analytical way within a dynamic business environment.

- Positive attitude, strong sense of ownership, and willingness to take on new challenges outside one’s immediate scope.

- Able to build trust quickly and collaborate effectively in a multicultural, matrixed team environment.

- Strong working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and slides (PowerPoint/Google Slides) for executive reporting

Preferred qualifications:
- Understanding of corporate finance and/or statistical analytics.

- Experience in live commerce, social commerce, marketplace businesses, or launching new initiatives is a plus.

- Build targeted buyer lists around specific teams, players, sports, categories, collections, and individual assets.

- Develop strategies to convert team and player fan bases into active Goldin bidders and collectors.

We are seeking an experienced Director of Export Controls and Trade Compliance to lead the continued development and operation of eBay’s global import and export compliance program, with an initial focus on the Export Control Reform Act and Export Administration Regulations (ECRA/EAR), as well as the Arms Export Control Act and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (AECA/ITAR).

This leader will develop a risk-based program tailored to eBay’s role as a global marketplace that facilitates transactions between third-party buyers and sellers. Because eBay’s responsibilities vary by transaction and shipping model, the role will assess and manage obligations arising when eBay engages in shipping, classification, filing, inspection, routing, or customs-related activities.

- Lead the enhancement and operation of eBay’s export controls and import/export compliance program, tailored to eBay’s role as a global marketplace connecting third-party buyers and sellers.
- Assess and manage eBay’s regulatory obligations across different transaction and shipping models, including circumstances in which eBay engages in shipping , classification, filing, inspection, routing, or customs-related activities.
- Enhance and/or establish policies, standards, governance, escalation protocols, and clear accountability for compliance with ECRA/EAR, AECA/ITAR, and related import/export requirements.
- Conduct risk assessments covering listings, products, sellers, buyers, end users, destinations, transaction patterns, shipping models, and logistics partners.
- Oversee processes for export jurisdiction and classification, licensing and authorization analysis, export eligibility, required filings, and escalation of potentially controlled or prohibited items.

- Build and lead a high-performing trade compliance team.

- Significant experience designing, implementing, operating, or evaluating an enterprise trade compliance program.
- Deep knowledge of the Export Control Reform Act, Export Administration Regulations, Arms Export Control Act, and International Traffic in Arms Regulations.
- Strong working knowledge of export jurisdiction and classification, the Commerce Control List, Export Control Classification Numbers, EAR99, the U.S. Munitions List, export licensing, license exceptions, restricted-party screening, end-use and end-user controls, brokering, freight forwarding, and recordkeeping requirements.
- Experience applying trade regulations to technology platforms, online marketplaces, e-commerce, logistics, payments, or other complex global business models.
- Demonstrated experience developing policies, procedures, risk assessments, controls, training, monitoring, testing, governance, and management reporting.
- Experience and success in partnering with Product, Engineering, Operations, Shipping, or other business teams to design and implement automated or technology-enabled compliance controls.

- Strong understanding of liability risks under U.S. export-control regimes and the importance of documented, risk-based compliance controls.

About the Team
eBay’s Global Compliance organization helps the company manage regulatory risk while enabling safe, trusted, and balanced commerce globally. We partner closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Shipping, Payments, Risk, Government Relations, and business leaders to develop practical and scalable compliance programs.

We are seeking an expert Senior Manager of Europe Trade Compliance & Export Controls, based in Amsterdam, to serve as the Trade Compliance lead for Europe and support eBay’s global import, export, and customs compliance program.

Reporting to the Director of Export Controls & Trade Compliance, this role will own the assessment and management of European country-specific export control, import, and customs requirements that may apply to eBay. The Senior Manager will also support the broader global program, including U.S. export-control requirements, where they affect eBay’s European operations, users, transactions, and cross-border commerce.

What You Will Accomplish
- Serve as eBay’s Trade Compliance lead for Europe, covering applicable EU and national export controls including the EU Dual-Use Regulation, German Foreign Trade and Payments Act and Ordinance (AWG/AWV), German national export controls, and applicable EU and German customs and trade-related requirements).
- Support the Director in developing and operating eBay’s global trade compliance program, including supporting U.S. nexus requirements under the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR).
- Assess eBay’s obligations across marketplace, transaction, shipping, and logistics models, including where eBay performs activities that may create direct import, export, or customs obligations.
- Provide subject-matter expertise and business facing training on EU export controls and customs requirements, including classification, licensing, customs valuation, country of origin, duties, declarations, and import/export formalities.
- Develop and maintain risk assessments, policies, standards, controls, governance, and processes addressing applicable trade compliance risks, including an effective and proportionate Internal Compliance Program (ICP) addressing export-control.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Shipping, Operations, Legal, Risk, and Sanctions Compliance to implement scalable controls addressing restricted items, destinations, end uses, shipping and routing risks, and customs requirements.
- Monitor and assess regulatory developments, including EU customs reform, EU Customs
- Data Hub, Trust and Check trader status, EU and national export control developments, import compliance, and evolving requirements for e-commerce and cross border

What you will bring:
- Pragmatic trade compliance experience
- Ability to apply complex regulatory requirements
- Experience working across Product, Engineering, Shipping, Operations, Legal, Risk, and Compliance
- Demonstrated experience in implementing practical, scalable controls
